profile.headline: Software Engineer | Creative Problem Solver
profile.summary:
Seasoned software engineer with 4 years of experience. Expertise in C#, JSON, MySQL, WPF, and
WinForms. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to enhance proprietary systems and improve
customer satisfaction. Revamped documentation processes, leading to more efficient issue resolution
within 6 months.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Online submission, grading, and retail/resale software for collectable memorabilia, Similar to EBay or Amazon Marketplace for trading cards, FUNKO POPs, comic books, etc. See upperdeckepack.com or theauthority.com for examples

-Enhanced Distribution Center (DC) product throughput by developing and supporting desktop applications and services (C#, JSON, MySQL, WPF, WinForms) for physical DC environment

-Enhanced project delivery within 6 months by enforcing AGILE rituals, improving team collaboration and efficiency as Scrum Master

-Trained and mentored 6 new team members within 1.25 years, including 3 summer interns, ensuring smooth onboarding and skill development.

-Implemented new system architecture, leading to significant performance gains over roughly 1.75 years through strategic design and efficient coding practices.

positions.title: Software Services Engineer
positions.description:
Equivalent to SAP pick by voice (PbV) functionality in SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM)

-Collaborated with cross-functional teams to enhance the proprietary SCDC voice picking system, leading to increased customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.

-Enhanced data security and integrity on customer SQL servers over ~1.5 years by implementing robust backup and recovery procedures

-Developed and deployed bug fixes to improve customer satisfaction and product stability

-Improved deployment turnaround time through off hours support, boosting customer satisfaction.

-Streamlined provisioning process for Android and Windows mobile devices to expedite shipping for voice picking use

-Maintained healthy customer relationships and company image through proactive communication and timely issue resolution

-Revamped documentation processes, leading to more efficient issue resolution for both internal and external stakeholders within 6 months.
positions.insights: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and +10 skills

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description: Administrative Assistant in the College in High School Department at the University of Pittsburgh
